observations: Photo 0 shows multiple large blue plastic/HDPE-looking drums/tanks stacked outdoors, with metal lids/ends and circular openings on top.
Photo 0 shows at least one drum with a side circular port/opening and a label sticker on the front face.
Photo 1 shows more of the same drums/tanks in rows; lids have central openings and there are side fittings/ports.

identity.kind: plastic storage drum (large, with lid and side port)

claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show drums with lids/ports and stickers, but no readable specification confirming liquid type compatibility.

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/size (price depends heavily on liters/gallon size).
risks.proof: A photo of the drum’s capacity marking (liters/US gallons) or a tape-measure shot showing height and diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst case for value: smallest common size in this category (as a generic small/medium drum), not a large bulk tank.

risks.risk: Previous contents / contamination (drums may have been used for chemicals, fuel, or food-grade items).
risks.proof: A photo of the label/markings that indicate previous use or chemical compatibility, plus confirmation of last contents in writing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed for potable/food use (as potentially contaminated), limiting buyer use to non-critical storage.

risks.risk: Leak risk / lid seal condition (plastic drums can crack or lids can warp).
risks.proof: A close-up of the lid gasket area and a video showing the drum filled with water for a short period (or a pressure/leak test).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly leaking/needs resealing (worst case: treat as requiring inspection/repair).

risks.risk: Material type uncertainty (HDPE vs other plastics; UV brittleness; thickness).
risks.proof: A photo of any material/spec marking on the drum and/or a thickness measurement (caliper) at a flat section.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used plastic storage drums with unknown material quality (worst case: not guaranteed for long-term outdoor chemical storage).

risks.risk: Condition variability across the stack (scratches, dents, cracks).
risks.proof: Photos of the exact drum you will buy: front, side port area, lid rim, and bottom edge; plus one close-up crack/dent check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average-worst condition among visible units (as used with possible cosmetic wear and minor damage).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the label/markings on the drum showing capacity (liters/gallons) and any compatibility/previous-use info.
Confirm last contents (what liquid was stored) and whether it was food-grade/chemical/fuel.
Provide a close-up of the lid rim and gasket/seal area, and the side port fitting.
Show the exact drum you will supply (not just the pile): front, side port, lid, and bottom edge; include any cracks/dents.
If possible, share a short video test: fill with water and show no seepage for a few minutes.
response.reason: From the photos, these are large blue plastic storage drums with lids/ports, but the key details that determine a safe resale price (capacity and condition/previous contents) are not readable or verifiable. Without that, any price would be guesswork.
